evidence_level: Maintainer-curated excerpts from private retained captures; not raw independently verifiable device evidence.

selection_provenance.source_identity: Neutral source IDs and whole-source SHA-256 replace private paths. Phase labels are maintainer annotations.
selection_provenance.line_numbering: 1-based inclusive line numbers from UTF-8 source split into lines; logcat buffer header counts as line 1. No reordering within excerpts.
selection_provenance.hash_scope: SHA-256 covers exact original file bytes before redaction, including newline bytes.
selection_provenance.selection_rule: For source_A, retain the init fatal-signal entry and its following helper-failure line, plus the complete adjacent IWLAN Java exception stack. For source_B, retain the init fatal-signal entry and its following helper-failure line. Buffer headers and unselected content are not published.
selection_provenance.authentication_limit: Hashes bind the retained source bytes if they are independently obtained; without those private bytes they do not independently establish authenticity, completeness or absence of other faults.

redactions.operation: Replace the leading MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm field with [timestamp redacted] in every excerpted line.
redactions.reason: Avoid publishing precise device activity times. Absolute timing and elapsed time cannot be reconstructed from these excerpts.

redactions.operation: Do not publish host/device private file locations, full logs, APK/DEX bytes or tombstones.
redactions.reason: Minimize disclosure of unrelated device, application and network state.

supported_observations.text: The selected r3 buffer records a .qtidataservices Java fatal exception: a null List is dereferenced by List.stream() in QualifiedNetworksService.java:186, reached from the vendor updateQualifiedNetworks method at line 122.
The selected r3 entry records SIGABRT in an init-named process with PID/TID 981, followed by a crash_dump helper failure. The recorded PID is not 1.
A selected working-40922 rollback entry has the same broad signal/process-name pattern with PID/TID 1024, also followed by a helper failure.

limits: The excerpts show failures, not absence of other failures or overall device stability.

The IWLAN stack alone does not identify the triggering modem response, SIM/APN/slot, module interaction or timing condition. The separate private-DEX analysis is described in r3_vendor_qns_init_diagnosis.json; this excerpt is not independent reproduction of that analysis.

The init entries do not establish the parent process, service identity, native abort message, stack, precise cause or harmlessness. A common-looking signal on two kernels does not prove a common cause.
Neither the stack nor the rollback comparison proves that the kernel or modules were uninvolved.
This report does not alter runtime test results or claim that cellular calling, IMS or VoWiFi has been validated.

privacy_review.scope: All 15 selected lines were inspected before publication into the local public-report directory.
privacy_review.result: Selected text contains no device serial, IMEI, account, token, URL, IP/MAC/SSID/APN identifier, network payload, or private absolute path. Android class/package names and ephemeral PIDs are deliberately retained.
